answer_1.quote: Our work aims to improve coherence in extractive summarization... We propose a comprehensive dataset ... to improve coherence in extractive summarization while integrating natural language feedback ...
answer_1.outputs: Extractive summaries (selected sentences) that are coherent

answer_2.quote: We use Rouge-L to evaluate model performance... In addition, we evaluated summaries using G-Eval with a coherence metric.

answer_3.quote: We utilized the coherence metric from G-Eval ... with a "GPT-4o" version ... to assess the generated summaries.

answer_4.quote: We asked three independent human evaluators (graduate student volunteers) to assess the summaries... they were asked to choose their preferred summary and rate each summary's coherence on a Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators chose preferred summary among alternatives and rated coherence on a 1-5 Likert scale.
